caption_L1: This is a bar plot named Chained consumer price index (C-CPI-U) of all urban consumers in the United States from 2000 to 2019 , at year-end. There is a categorical scale starting at 2000 and ending at 2019* along the x-axis, marked December value. A linear scale of range 0 to 150 can be seen along the y-axis, labeled Chained Consumer Price Index (1999=100).
caption_L2L3: That during the years the value has increased to a point of nearly 50%.
